description: A Perl script for extracting target, device, architecture, and kernel information from OpenWrt build system Makefiles, with functions to parse target info and device info, and command-line interface for querying this data.

methods.name: parse_targetinfo
methods.description: Parses target information from make output for a given target directory and subtarget, populating global hashes with target names, architectures, and kernels.

methods.name: parse_devices
methods.description: Parses device profile information from make output for a given target directory and subtarget, populating global hashes with device profiles and names.

methods.name: get_targetinfo
methods.description: Iterates over target Makefiles to gather target, subtarget, and feature information.

methods.name: get_devices
methods.description: Retrieves device information for a specified target/subtarget.
